an4.210:1.1: vo bhikkhave desessāmi pāpadhammena pāpadhammatarañ ca
an4.210:1.2: kalyāṇadhammañ ca kalyāṇadhammena kalyāṇadhammatarañ ca, taṃ suṇātha . . . pe . . . 2.
an4.210:2.2: Idha bhikkhave ekacco micchādiṭṭhiko hoti . . . pe . . . micchāñāṇī hoti, micchāvimutti hoti.
an4.210:3.2: Idha bhikkhave ekacco attanā ca micchādiṭṭhiko hoti parañ ca micchādiṭṭhiyā samādapeti . . . pe . . . attanā ca micchāñāṇī hoti parañ ca micchāñāṇe samādapeti,
an4.210:3.3: attanā ca micchāvimutti hoti parañ ca micchāvimuttiyā samādapeti.
an4.210:4.2: Idha bhikkhave ekacco sammadiṭṭhiko hoti, . . . pe . . . sammāñāṇī hoti, sammāvimutti hoti.
an4.210:5.2: Idha bhikkhave ekacco attanā ca sammādiṭṭhiko hoti parañ ca sammādiṭṭhiyā samādapeti . . . pe . . . attanā ca sammāñāṇī hoti parañ ca sammāñāṇe samādapeti,
an4.210:5.3: attanā ca sammāvimutti hoti parañ ca sammāvimuttiyā samādapeti.
an4.210:5.4: Ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave kalyāṇadhammena kalyāṇadhammataro. [Tass' uddānaṃ:
